title_zh: PESI 免費兩日創傷培訓：Kate Truitt 談創傷神經科學與創傷後成長
title_en: PESI free 2-day clinical trauma training Kate Truitt neuroscience posttraumatic growth
summary_zh: 臨床心理學家 Kate Truitt 主講的 PESI 免費兩日線上培訓，2026 年 11 月 3–4 日美中時間上午 8 時至下午 4 時直播。內容涵蓋發展與依附創傷、PTSD 與複雜性創傷、解離、階段式治療。直播與三日重播免費，CE 學分與 CCTP 證書另收費。
summary_en: Clinical psychologist and applied neuroscientist Kate Truitt leads PESI's free two-day online trauma training on 3-4 November 2026 (8am-4pm US Central): developmental and attachment trauma, PTSD and complex trauma, dissociation and phase-based treatment. Live attendance and three-day replay are free; CE credit and the CCTP credential are available for a fee.
caution: 直播與重播免費，但 CE 學分與 CCTP 證書另收費；兩日課程不等於完整的複雜創傷治療訓練。
brief_zh: 主題：發展與依附創傷、PTSD、解離、階段式治療
直播與三日重播免費；CE 學分與 CCTP 證書另收費
supervision_questions: 階段式創傷治療的穩定化階段，我們在本地個案的實際執行最常卡在哪一步？

related.title_en: PESI free live training transforming father wounds clinical tools
related.summary_zh: PESI 心理師免費直播系列。2026 年 10 月 30 日線上舉行，主題是處理女性個案的父親傷痕，聚焦自我價值、界限與關係模式的臨床工具。參加免費，頁面未列學分。
related.summary_en: PESI's free live online training on 30 October 2026, led by Terri Cole: clinical tools for working with women whose father wounds shape self-worth, boundaries and relational patterns. Free to attend; no CE credits listed on the page.

related.title_zh: Pat Ogden 免費錄影講座：感覺動作心理治療談創傷下的復原力
related.title_en: Free Pat Ogden webinar on resilience amid trauma
related.summary_zh: Leading Edge Seminars 與 Sensorimotor Psychotherapy Institute（SPI）、SensorimotorItalia.it 合作，免費公開 Pat Ogden 與 Rebeca Farca 的錄影講座「Building Resilience in Times of War, Violence & Other Traumatic Events」。內容介紹如何協助長期處於壓力與威脅下的案主，並附講義、給案主用的 PEACE protocol 與給臨床人員的 SPI protocol 可下載。
related.summary_en: Leading Edge Seminars, with the Sensorimotor Psychotherapy Institute and SensorimotorItalia.it, offers a free recorded webinar by Pat Ogden and Rebeca Farca, 'Building Resilience in Times of War, Violence & Other Traumatic Events'. It shows how to help clients living with long-term stress and threat, with a downloadable handout, a PEACE protocol for clients and an SPI protocol for clinicians.

training.provider: Leading Edge Seminars（與 Sensorimotor Psychotherapy Institute 合作）

related.title_zh: EMDR 與部分工作治療複雜性創傷（免費直播）
related.title_en: EMDR & Parts Work for Treating Complex Trauma (Free Live Event)
related.summary_zh: Psychotherapy Networker 舉辦的免費直播課程，於 2026-10-22 美東時間上午 10:30 至下午 6:00 線上舉行。課程聚焦以 EMDR 結合部分工作（parts work）與身體取向技巧，協助臨床工作者降低個案防衛、促進創傷處理。原價 $249.99，現免費參加，需線上報名。
related.summary_en: Free live online event from Psychotherapy Networker on 22 Oct 2026 (10:30am–6:00pm EDT) on combining EMDR, parts work and body-oriented techniques for complex trauma; listed at $0 instead of $249.99.
